mentions.context_excerpt: Editor’s note: This blog is a part of Into the Omniverse , a series focused on how developers, 3D practitioners and enterprises can transform their workflows using the latest advances in OpenUSD and NVIDIA Omniverse.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: A “sim-first” approach unlocks these critical skills by enabling parallel training of hundreds or thousands of robot instances using real robot-captured data and synthetic data in simulation environments. Universal Scene Description (OpenUSD) provides the foundational framework for this advanced robot development, serving as a scalable, interoperable data standard that enables developers to build physically accurate virtual worlds where robots can practice and perfect their skills before transferring them to real-world applications.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Newton Physics Engine : While robots learn faster and safer in simulation , humanoid robots — with complex joints, balance and movements — are pushing today’s physics engines to the limit.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Codeveloped by Google DeepMind, Disney Research and NVIDIA, and managed by the Linux Foundation , Newton is an open-source, GPU-accelerated physics engine to advance robot learning.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Codeveloped by Google DeepMind, Disney Research and NVIDIA, and managed by the Linux Foundation , Newton is an open-source, GPU-accelerated physics engine to advance robot learning.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Built on NVIDIA Warp and OpenUSD , Newton enables robots to learn complex tasks more precisely while working seamlessly with robot learning frameworks like MuJoCo Playground and NVIDIA Isaac Lab .

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Tune in to an upcoming livestream for a Newton beta demonstration to learn about Newton’s core features and how to get started on Newton with NVIDIA Isaac Lab.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Isaac GR00T N1.6 : To perform humanlike tasks in the physical world, humanoids must understand ambiguous instructions and navigate unforeseen scenarios. The latest Isaac GR00T N1.6 open robot foundation model, available soon on Hugging Face, integrates NVIDIA Cosmos Reason , an open reasoning vision language model built for physical AI . Cosmos Reason serves as the robot’s deep-thinking brain and transforms vague instructions into step-by-step action plans using prior knowledge, common sense and physics understanding.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Agility Robotics uses NVIDIA Isaac Lab to train a whole-body control foundation model for its Digit robot. Isaac Sim and OpenUSD enable precise digital twin creation of customer facilities, delivering a scalable way to optimize the robot’s operation before deployment.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Lightwheel developed the Lightwheel Simulation Platform, built on NVIDIA Omniverse . Lightwheel is also building simulation-ready assets that use the NVIDIA USD Search application programming interface to streamline asset discovery and assemble accurate digital twins to help robotics developers accelerate their training and simulation workflows.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Mentee Robotics harnesses NVIDIA’s three-computer architecture to develop MenteeBot’s sophisticated learning capabilities, using OpenUSD as the foundation for developing synthetic data generation pipelines in Isaac Sim.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Universal Robots uses the NVIDIA Isaac platform for comprehensive robot simulation and learning, tapping OpenUSD to create interoperable digital twins of manufacturing environments that validate cobot safety protocols and optimize human-robot interaction across diverse industrial settings. Inbolt, a partner in the Universal Robots ecosystem, delivers dynamic vision guidance systems that enable robots to adapt to their environment on the fly, handling production variations with ease.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Wandelbots , a German robotics software company, is helping Volkswagen shorten automation projects at its Transparent Factory in Dresden. Using Wandelbots NOVA — an Isaac Sim–integrated, no-code teaching platform — assembly workers can train robots to pick-and-place in a virtual twin, before deployment.

mentions.context_excerpt: Attend Physical AI and Robotics Day on Tuesday, Oct. 28, at NVIDIA GTC Washington, D.C., which will feature curated sessions on how digital twins, robot learning and OpenUSD are shaping the future of physical AI. Earn an industry-recognized OpenUSD Development certification , offered at no additional charge to conference attendees.
